version: 0.4.0
kind: shared-metadata
schema_type: shared

metadata:

  name: shared-metadata.schema
  description: Reusable metadata block for all Prismata objects.

spec:
  target_kind: shared-metadata
  naming:
    file_suffix: .schema.yaml
  versioning:
    semver: true

fields:
  - name: createdBy
    path: createdBy
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: createdAt
    path: createdAt
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: updatedBy
    path: updatedBy
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: updatedAt
    path: updatedAt
    type: string
    required: false

  - name: tags
    path: tags
    type: array
    required: false
    item:
      type: string

object:
  createdBy: ""
  createdAt: ""
  updatedBy: ""
  updatedAt: ""
  tags: []
